## Summary

What you want, and why.

## Proposed shape

How it could work, including any decisions already made and any
options that still need a choice.

## Effort and likelihood

Every issue and enhancement is scored when it is filed (see
[CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/oliverclaude/syncfs/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md)). Lower is better on both
axes. Please propose:

- **Effort** (1–5): 1 is the smallest or easiest change, 5 is the largest or hardest.
- **Likelihood** (1–5): 1 is the most likely to be needed, or to hit users or CI; 5 is rare.
- **Reason** (one line): why those scores.
